nodes.name: Schedule — Hourly Usage Sweep
nodes.notes: Timezone comes from workflow Settings → Timezone (America/New_York in this export). Change both together.

nodes.name: Schedule — Daily Reconcile 07:00
nodes.notes: Fires 07:00 in the workflow timezone (America/New_York). Runs the Clay CSV ingest, the cost-per-verified-record drift check and the expiry forecast.

nodes.name: Webhook — Clay Row Event
nodes.notes: Clay HTTP API column POSTs one event per enriched row. Each POST costs 1 Clay Action — see _README.md §What the monitor itself costs.

nodes.name: HTTP — ZoomInfo Usage
nodes.notes: fullResponse + neverError so a 401/429 reaches the parser as data instead of failing the execution silently to zero.

nodes.name: HTTP — Apollo Usage Stats
nodes.notes: Requires a MASTER API key (scope api_usage_stats_read). Endpoint itself costs 0 credits and returns rate-limit counters, not credits.

nodes.name: HTTP — Clay Usage Export
nodes.notes: Clay has no public credit-balance endpoint. This pulls the CSV you export from Settings → Usage to a signed URL or object-store path.
